# GitHub Social Preview Setup

## Social Preview Image

A professional social preview image has been generated for your repository.

**Image**: `github_social_preview.png` (in artifacts)

### How to Add to GitHub

1. Go to your repository on GitHub
2. Click **Settings**
3. Scroll to **Social preview**
4. Click **Edit**
5. Upload the `github_social_preview.png` image
6. Save changes

This image will appear when your repository is shared on social media, Slack, LinkedIn, etc.
